noSpecsYet: No specifications yet. Type one to add it.
specForNewItem: New material: the specification is saved with it.

source.REQUEST: From an earlier request estimate (nothing bought yet)

checklistComplete: Everything is checked. These goods can go into inventory.
checklistIncomplete: Not everything is checked yet, so these goods cannot go into inventory.

check.items: Every line is a known item of the PO

reason.NO_REQUEST: This PO has no material request
reason.NO_SITE_BILLS: This site-bill PO has no bills
reason.CONTRACT: Contract bill: the approved contract stands in for it
reason.NON_VENDOR_WITHOUT_REQUEST: A non-vendor PO must be raised from its request
reason.NO_QUOTATION: A vendor PO must come from a finalized quotation
reason.SITE_BILLS_ON_VENDOR: Site bills must be on the non-vendor site purchases PO
reason.VENDOR_WITHOUT_QUOTATION: Vendor PO raised without a quotation
reason.QUOTATION_OF_OTHER_REQUEST: The quotation belongs to a different request
reason.NO_GATE_PASS: No gate pass is linked to this receipt
reason.LINE_NOT_ON_PO: A line is not on the purchase order
reason.LINE_NOT_IN_CATALOG: A line is not linked to the item list yet

settingsCardBody: One list of materials and services for every project. Merge duplicates, fix wrongly entered items and keep each item's specifications.
manageHelp: Changes here apply to every request, quotation, PO, gate pass, receipt and stock item that uses the item, in every project.
confirmMerge: Merge "{{source}}" into "{{target}}"? Every document and stock item using it moves to "{{target}}".
wrongTitle: Names that are probably not an item
kindChangeWarn: Changing between material and service gives the item a new code.
renameSpecPrompt: Rename this specification (every line using it is updated):
confirmDeleteSpec: Remove "{{spec}}" from the list? Lines that already use it keep it.
specsHint: Outlined ones came with the item; tap a specification to rename it.
modeMergeHelp: "{{item}}" is a duplicate: everything using it moves to the item you pick.
modeSpecHelp: "{{item}}" was entered as an item but is really a specification (for example "160/6 ISI" is PVC Pipe, 160mm 6kg ISI).
confirmMakeSpec: Make "{{source}}" the specification "{{spec}}" of "{{target}}"? Every line using it is updated.
pricesNoSpecHint: Prices of every specification of this item together; each line's price flag compares the same specification only.
